description.short_caption: Erythematous, swollen lower leg with bullae formation.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a lower leg and foot with marked erythema, swelling, and shiny skin. The affected area extends from the foot to the mid-calf. Bullae are visible on the anterior surface of the leg, indicating fluid accumulation under the skin. The surrounding tissue appears tense and inflamed, suggesting a severe infectious or inflammatory process. The image is taken in a clinical setting with the patient lying on a white towel.
visible_findings: diffuse erythema of the lower leg and foot
bullae formation on the anterior leg
involvement extending from foot to mid-calf
